title: Orthogonal crypto sleeves, round 3: cross-sectional size, MAX (lottery) and illiquidity factors on the 60-coin universe (3 trials)
construction: as the wide carry: listed >= 60 days, long top third / short bottom third of the score, inverse-vol legs, 7-day hold in 7 tranches, 5 bp + funding (premium_carry_breadth accounting)

trials.A size (Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu 2022): score = -log(30-day mean daily quote volume): long the smallest third, short the largest
trials.B MAX (lottery; Li et al. 2021): score = -(maximum daily return over the last 30 days): long low-MAX, short high-MAX
trials.C illiquidity (Amihud): score = 30-day mean of |daily return| / daily quote volume: long the most illiquid third, short the most liquid

bars: orthogonal candidate: sleeve DEV (2020-22) > 0, TEST (2023-24) >= 0.8, HOLD (2025-26) >= 0.5, |daily corr with v8.6 2022-26| <= 0.2; also reported: v8.6 with the sleeve (strict rule)
